package.name: go2_survey_description
package.description:
TF frames for the Go2 survey rig: Livox Mid-360 (pitched nose-down so it can see the floor) and RealSense D435i.
Frames, not geometry. Nav2 needs a footprint and a TF tree; SLAM needs sensor extrinsics. Neither needs a visual mesh of a dog, and carrying one would mean maintaining a copy of Unitree's link geometry for no gain.
